environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. SQLite database contains user records including password_hash column. The HMAC_SECRET environment variable is set but the require_api_key decorator has a bug (hmac.new should be hmac.HMAC or hmac module doesn't have 'new' — actually in Python hmac module the function is hmac.new which IS valid). API keys are distributed to internal services.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP passthrough on port 8080
config.api_key_distribution: shared among 12 internal microservices via SSM Parameter Store
